svg.title: Draw the foggy hillside
svg.desc: One large empty framed panel for the student's own drawing of the loss bowl, with a dashed baseline underneath labelled w equals 0 at the left and w equals 8 at the right. A panel below lists what a good answer contains: a bowl with w along the bottom and loss up the side, the bottom of the bowl at w equals 4 where the loss is 0, the point at w equals 0 where the loss is 16 marked, a straight line just touching the curve at that point with the numbers minus 8 written beside it as the slope, an arrow of length 2.4 to the right labelled 0.3 times 8, six dots marching in from w equals 0 to w equals 3.98 with the arrows getting shorter each time, and the two sentences that the slope points uphill so you step the other way and that a flattening slope means you are arriving.
svg.text: The bowl, one tangent, and six shrinking steps.
What a good answer looks like
· w along the bottom, loss up the side, both labelled
· the bowl bottoms out at w = 4, where the loss is 0
· the point (0, 16) marked, because that is the start
· a straight line JUST touching the curve there, with
−8 written beside it — that is the slope
· an arrow 2.4 long pointing right, labelled 0.3 × 8
· the arrows between them getting SHORTER every time
· ‘the slope points uphill, so step the other way’
· ‘a flattening slope means I am arriving’
